encoder_method_note:
The message is encoded in the heights of the fourteen skyline buildings read left to right: each building's height in pixels is ten times the alphabetical position of a letter (a=1 … z=26), so 130 = m, 10 = a, 180 = r, 30 = c, 210 = u, 190 = s, and so on. The river gap between the two clusters of buildings marks the space between "marcus" (six buildings on the left bank) and "aurelius" (eight buildings on the right bank). All other elements (stars, moon, windows pattern, ripples, antennas) are decorative and carry no data.
